    # -- validation ------------------------------------------------------

    def validate(self):
        req = self.req
        require(exact_keys(req, TOP_KEYS))
        require(is_int(req["version"]) and req["version"] == 1)

        self.K = req["window"]
        require(is_int(self.K) and 1 <= self.K <= 8)

        self._validate_schema(req["schema"])
        self._validate_policy(req["policy"])

        atoms = req["atoms"]
        require(isinstance(atoms, list) and 0 <= len(atoms) <= 20)
        self.atom_fns = [self._compile_atom(ast) for ast in atoms]

        train = req["train"]
        probes = req["probes"]
        queries = req["queries"]
        require(isinstance(train, list))
        require(isinstance(probes, list))
        require(isinstance(queries, list))

        train_traces = self._validate_traces(train)
        probe_traces = self._validate_traces(probes)
        query_traces = self._validate_traces(queries)

        seen_ids = set()
        for traces in (train_traces, probe_traces, query_traces):
            for tr in traces:
                require(tr["id"] not in seen_ids)
                seen_ids.add(tr["id"])

        total_traces = len(train_traces) + len(probe_traces) + len(query_traces)
        require(total_traces <= 128)
        total_rows = sum(
            len(tr["rows"]) for tr in train_traces + probe_traces + query_traces
        )
        require(total_rows <= 16384)

        sources = []
        for tr in train_traces:
            if tr["source"] not in sources:
                sources.append(tr["source"])
        require(len(sources) <= 16)
        self.train_sources = sources

        self.train_ctx = self._build_contexts(train_traces)
        self.probe_ctx = self._build_contexts(probe_traces)
        self.query_ctx = self._build_contexts(query_traces)
        require(len(self.train_ctx) <= 4096)
        require(len(self.probe_ctx) <= 128)
        require(len(self.query_ctx) <= 1024)

    def _validate_schema(self, schema):
        require(isinstance(schema, list) and 1 <= len(schema) <= 32)
        for fdef in schema:
            require(isinstance(fdef, dict))
            require("type" in fdef)
            ftype = fdef["type"]
            require(isinstance(ftype, str))
            if ftype == "ID":
                require(exact_keys(fdef, ("name", "type", "values")))
                values = fdef["values"]
                require(isinstance(values, list) and 1 <= len(values) <= 32)
                seen = set()
                for value in values:
                    require(isinstance(value, str) and IDVAL_RE.match(value))
                    require(value not in seen)
                    seen.add(value)
                domain = frozenset(values)
            elif ftype == "FLAG":
                require(exact_keys(fdef, ("name", "type")))
                domain = None
            elif ftype in NUMERIC_TYPES:
                require(exact_keys(fdef, ("name", "type", "min", "max")))
                lo = fdef["min"]
                hi = fdef["max"]
                require(is_int(lo) and INT32_MIN <= lo <= INT32_MAX)
                require(is_int(hi) and INT32_MIN <= hi <= INT32_MAX)
                require(lo <= hi)
                domain = (lo, hi)
            else:
                raise SchemaError("unknown field type")
            name = fdef["name"]
            require(isinstance(name, str) and NAME_RE.match(name))
            require(name not in self.findex)
            self.findex[name] = len(self.fields)
            self.fields.append({"name": name, "type": ftype, "domain": domain})
            self.ftypes.append(ftype)

    def _validate_policy(self, policy):
        require(exact_keys(policy, ("max_width", "min_support", "min_witness")))
        width = policy["max_width"]
        support = policy["min_support"]
        witness = policy["min_witness"]
        require(is_int(width) and 1 <= width <= 4)
        require(is_int(support) and 1 <= support <= 4096)
        require(is_int(witness) and 1 <= witness <= 4096)
        self.max_width = width
        self.min_support = support
        self.min_witness = witness

    def _validate_traces(self, traces):
        require(isinstance(traces, list))
        nfields = len(self.fields)
        out = []
        for trace in traces:
            require(exact_keys(trace, ("id", "source", "rows")))
            tid = trace["id"]
            src = trace["source"]
            require(isinstance(tid, str) and TRACE_RE.match(tid))
            require(isinstance(src, str) and TRACE_RE.match(src))
            rows = trace["rows"]
            require(isinstance(rows, list))
            parsed = []
            seen_times = set()
            for row in rows:
                require(exact_keys(row, ("t", "values")))
                t = row["t"]
                require(is_int(t) and INT32_MIN <= t <= INT32_MAX)
                require(t not in seen_times)
                seen_times.add(t)
                values = row["values"]
                require(isinstance(values, list) and len(values) == nfields)
                for value, field in zip(values, self.fields):
                    self._check_value(value, field)
                parsed.append((t, values))
            out.append({"id": tid, "source": src, "rows": parsed})
        return out

    @staticmethod
    def _check_value(value, field):
        ftype = field["type"]
        if ftype == "FLAG":
            require(isinstance(value, bool))
        elif ftype == "ID":
            require(isinstance(value, str) and value in field["domain"])
        else:
            lo, hi = field["domain"]
            require(is_int(value) and lo <= value <= hi)

    def _build_contexts(self, traces):
        K = self.K
        contexts = []
        for trace in traces:
            rows = sorted(trace["rows"], key=lambda r: r[0])
            n = len(rows)
            if n < K:
                continue
            for start in range(n - K + 1):
                window = [rows[start + i][1] for i in range(K)]
                contexts.append(
                    (trace["id"], trace["source"], rows[start + K - 1][0], window)
                )
        return contexts
